title: Run locked follow-up for real pending NHS score-fix checkout starts
acceptance_criteria: Re-read /api/v1/admin/geo-jobs through tools/geo-jobs-redacted-read.sh before selecting any row-specific follow-up.
Target only freshly confirmed real_candidate pending rows; ignore test_like paid, lead, or pending rows.
Take the required duplicate-safe public-action lock before drafting or sending customer contact.
Frame the offer as site-owner remediation for public agent-readiness signals, not paid ranking placement or scoring-method bypass.

title: Dry-run cleanup for stale test-like NHS score-fix rows
acceptance_criteria: Use the redaction helper to produce an aggregate-only view, then create a dry-run cleanup list that contains row ids only if a production-data mutation gate is active.
Classify stale test-like rows only with high-confidence test markers; do not infer from domain class alone.
Do not delete or update production rows from the scout runtime.
After a gated cleanup, re-run the aggregate and confirm pending rows represent real checkout abandonment rather than test noise.
